content:
OpenAI is developing a feature that will let users export ChatGPT-generated stickers directly to WhatsApp. Here are the details.

The feature is still in development.

No matter where you are or how old you are, it is almost impossible to get through a day—or even a few hours—without sending or receiving a WhatsApp sticker.

For those unfamiliar with them, stickers in messaging apps are small images that users can send in chats, similar to emojis or GIFs. Stickers are typically organised into sticker packs, which may contain custom illustrations or meme-style images with text.

WhatsApp already has a built-in AI sticker generator powered by Meta AI, allowing users to create images via text prompts. Now, according to a report by Android Authority, OpenAI appears to be working on bringing similar sticker generation capabilities to ChatGPT.

According to the website, the latest version of the ChatGPT Android app contains strings of code related to creating, exporting, and downloading stickers, which read as follows:

ChatGPT stickers add to messaging app add to WhatsApp WhatsApp (minimum 3) unable to add stickers to WhatsApp download stickers

Android Authority added that the "minimum three" requirement comes from WhatsApp, not OpenAI.

Since the feature was discovered by tearing apart an APK file, it remains unclear when—or even if—it will be officially released.
